description: This file declares functions related to MKL-DNN optimized linear operations in PyTorch, including pointwise and binary pointwise linear functions, MKL linear, and scaled matrix multiplication.

methods.name: mkldnn_linear_pointwise
methods.description: Performs a pointwise linear operation optimized with MKL-DNN, with configurable attributes and scalars.

methods.name: mkldnn_linear_pointwise_binary
methods.description: Performs a binary pointwise linear operation with MKL-DNN, taking an additional tensor input.

methods.name: mkl_linear
methods.description: Performs a linear operation optimized with MKL, with prepacking support.

methods.name: mkldnn_scaled_mm
methods.description: Performs a scaled matrix multiplication with optional bias and output dtype specification.
